# AGENTS.md — jspace-probes

Interpretability lab probing LLM "J-spaces" (Jacobian lens / global
workspace). Python, not a JS project — there is no `package.json` and no
build step.

**`CLAUDE.md` is the authoritative agent contract.** Read it first. It
carries the mandatory PRE-DESIGN PROTOCOL, the environment limits (no swap;
never load Qwen3.6-27B unquantized), the layer-band reference, and the
research-board rules. This file exists only so agents that read `AGENTS.md`
by convention get pointed there instead of guessing.

## Orientation

- Code: `probes/` (49 scripts). Entry points: `probes/lab.py` (`run()` executes
  declarative specs), `probes/probe.py` (model/lens CONFIGS), `probes/board.py`
  (research board — the ONLY way to edit `board/board.json`).
- Results: `results/<id>/{record.json, thoughts.md}` + `results/index.json`.
- Living docs, all binding: `MECHANICS.md` (mandatory pre-read for any
  steering/ablation), `PREDICTIONS.md` (replication ledger — grep before
  designing), `GLOSSARY.md` (binding vocabulary for new writing),
  `BOARD.md` (open threads).
- Python is `.venv/bin/python`. No system pip.

## Code-structure index

`.mentis/` is a Mnestis call graph over `probes/`, with an MCP server in
`.mcp.json`. Rebuild:

```bash
mnestis build probes -o ../.mentis && rm -f probes/AGENTS.md
```

It indexes **code structure only** — `.md`/`.json` are invisible to it, so it
knows nothing about the science (domains 0, flows 0 here). Trust its symbol
names, not its line numbers (0–2 lines early). It does not substitute for the
PRE-DESIGN PROTOCOL. Full caveats: `CLAUDE.md` § Mnestis.
